question: The foundation stone of the new capital, New Delhi, was laid in December, 1911 by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** "King George V".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The foundation stone of the new capital, New Delhi, was laid in December 1911 by King George V and Queen Mary.
 
• King shifted his capital from **Calcutta to Delhi.**
 
• The king showed the desire to design and plan the capital beautifully.
 
• **Sir Edwin and Sir Herbert **were the architects who made public buildings as beautiful as the countries of Europe and America.
 
• Viceroy's house, North block, and South block were in front.
 
• During the construction of the new capital world war broke out and soldiers were sent to war zones.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Queen Victoria I**

 
 
• ​From **20 June 1837** until her passing in 1901, Victoria ruled the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.
 
• The **Victorian era** is named after her **63-year and 216-day** reign, which was the longest of any British monarch before her.
 
 
 
• **King Edward VIII**
 
 
• ​From **January 20, 1936**, until his abdication in December of that same year, **Edward VIII,** subsequently known as the **Duke of Windsor,** reigned as **Emperor of India, King of the United Kingdom, and Dominions** of the British Empire.
 
 
 
• **Queen Elizabeth II**
 
 
• ​From **6 February 1952 **until her passing in 2022, **Elizabeth II** reigned over the **United Kingdom** and other Commonwealth territories.
 
• During her lifetime, she served as the queen regnant of 32 independent nations, and at the time of her passing, she was the ruler of 15 realms.
 
 

e1:T
